newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Nov domestic output up 17.3% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Nov domestic output up 17.3% yr/yr.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Thursday its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas ouptut in November were as follows:
It was the fifth successive month that domestic production had risen on a year-on-year basis, reflecting strong domestic sales of Toyota's new models.

It was the seventh successive month that exports had risen on a year-on-year basis, helped by increased shipments to Asia and the Middle East, while exports to the United States fell one percent from a year earlier in response to increased production of the new Camry at Toyota's Kentucky plant.
It was the third successive month that domestic sales rose on a year-on-year basis, and it was also the third successive month that overseas production climbed on a year-on-year basis.
